objectTemplate.name: EntraTest All: Naming Template
objectTemplate.description: Naming template for roles (Entra groups) and orgs (Entra enterprise applications) imported from the Entra test tenant. Entra display names are not unique, so the object name is the display name plus an iteration token that midPoint increases until the name is free. Referenced by the Entra test archetypes.

mapping.name: entra-test-unique-name
mapping.description: Sets the object name to the Entra display name, suffixed with the iteration token when that name is already taken.
mapping.documentation: Entra allows several groups or applications with the same display name (for example two groups named secGroupPSTMAN), while midPoint names must be unique. The first object keeps the clean display name; each further object with the same display name gets a numbered suffix such as " (1)". Objects without a display name fall back to their Entra object id.
